description:

JOB MISSION   HwIT is seeking a Packaging  Product Development Engineer focused on optical commutations products. You will be a key technical contributor supporting the hardware lifecycle of our photonic modules  from assisting in mechanical/thermal simulations and 3D CAD design to the execution, validation, and optimization of cleanroom packaging processes.  Your main focus will be a hands-on environment bridging RD design with manufacturing reality: supporting multiphysics simulations, detailing micro-assemblies, executing DOEs (Design of Experiments) for method validation, and technically investigating root causes to ensure structural integrity and maximize yield in global scale production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1. Product Development and Validation  ·       Mechanical  Optomechanical Design for Packaging: Develop 3D CAD models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for high-precision optoelectronic packages, test fixtures, and structural assemblies, applying GDT standards.  ·       Multiphysics  Thermal Simulation: Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to simulate thermal dissipation, mechanical stress, and structural integrity of photonic modules.  ·       Prototyping  Design Validation: Support the rapid prototyping phase and work closely with the Reliability testing team to validate simulation models against empirical data from testing (e.g., Telcordia GR-468, MIL-STD).  2. Process Development and Validation  ·       Critical Parameter Optimization: Assist in defining and optimizing critical process parameters such as die attach (e.g., conductive epoxies, eutectic soldering), wire bonding, and optical alignment.  ·       Encapsulation Techniques: Develop hermetic and semi-hermetic encapsulation techniques for photonic modules.  ·       Material Qualification: Validate new materials, adhesives, and sealing processes according to high-reliability standards.  3. Yield Optimization and Troubleshooting  ·       Root Cause Investigation: Run investigative activities in cleanroom processes to detect the root cause of issues affecting the yield and assembly times of photonic components.  ·       Design of Experiments (DOE): Run DOEs to characterize processes, define critical variables, and find the best assembly recipes.  ·       SPC Alignment: Validate and approve operational methods and process parameters consistent with the Statistical Process Control (SPC) required by Product Engineering.            4. NPI Integration and Manufacturability  ·       Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Execute DFM and development activities in packaging components under senior guidance, promoting technical alignment between suppliers and developers, and evaluating the technical feasibility of new components.  ·       Team Training: Documentation and training the operational team in the meticulous execution of complex encapsulation recipes and methodologies;  ·       Process Transference: Collaborate side-by-side with Product Engineers and Senior Packaging Engineers to validate assemblies and transfer packaging assembly processes to high-volume manufacturing sites.   CANDIDATE PROFILE   Education  Background  Essential:  ·       Bachelor s Degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or related fields.  ·       Minimum of 25 years of solid experience in microelectronic or optoelectronic packaging processes.  ·       Knowledge of structural adhesives, precision soldering, and interconnect metallurgy.  ·       Familiarity with failure analysis methodologies (SEM, EDS, X-Ray, Cross-section).  ·       Experience in optomechanical design, precision mechanics, or electronic hardware packaging.  ·       Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor) and understanding of GDT.  ·       Track record participating in thermal and structural simulations using tools like ANSYS, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Simulation.  Desirable:  ·       Experience with PICs (Photonic Integrated Circuits) and fiber-to-chip interfaces.  ·       Knowledge of reliability standards (MIL-STD-883, Telcordia GR-468, or NASA EEE-INST-002).  ·       Experience with continuous improvement tools (Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing).  ·       Knowledge of automation programming in Python, C#, or LabVIEW.  ·       Experience designing complex hermetic packages (e.g., Butterfly, TO-can) and managing micro-assembly tolerances.  ·       Background in designing customized mechanical fixtures for High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) and environmental testing.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native;   ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level) for day-to-day communication with international partners.  ·       Spanish: Desirable.

Trabalhar de acordo com regulamentos ambientais e normas para manuseio de gases refrigerantes.  Garantir o correto uso de EPIs e a organização dos materiais e ferramentas.  Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:  Atuar no treinamento e orientação de técnicos juniores e auxiliares.  Buscar aprimoramento contínuo por meio de treinamentos técnicos e certificações. title: Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿ em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Local: Campinas-SP (Híbrido 2x na semana) Caso more em a +2h de distância, o híbrido é 1x na semana. Sua principal missão será maximizar a performance e otimizar o funil através da produção de criativos dinâmicos em vídeo e motion graphics, atuando em um ambiente de alta exigência, velocidade e impacto.   Buscamos alguém com mentalidade 360o, forte domínio técnico em vídeo e motion, além de maturidade comportamental para lidar diretamente com executivos e stakeholders de alto nível.   Aqui, você terá autonomia real e será peça-chave na operação.   Principais Responsabilidades   Produzir criativos de alta performance focados em vídeo e motion graphics (aproximadamente 80% do escopo)  Editar vídeos para campanhas de Growth com alto volume de entregas   Gerenciar tarefas, prioridades e backlog diretamente com stakeholders do cliente   Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre V4 e cliente em temas relacionados à produção criativa   Desenvolver materiais complementares de design da squad, incluindo Landing Pages (cerca de 20% do escopo)  Garantir alinhamento visual e qualidade dos materiais conforme branding da V4 e do cliente   Trabalhar em parceria com outros designers da squad para garantir velocidade e consistência nas entregas    Requisitos Obrigatórios   Domínio de Figma, com capacidade de trabalhar em estruturas organizadas   Experiência comprovada com After Effects e Premiere   Forte experiência em Motion Graphics e edição de vídeo focada em performance   Domínio do Pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator e demais ferramentas necessárias)   Diferenciais   Experiência com otimização de funil e campanhas de alta verba   Vivência na criação e estruturação de Landing Pages   Histórico atuando em ambientes de Growth Marketing    Perfil Comportamental Esperado   Postura executiva e capacidade de adaptação a ambientes de alto nível   Maturidade e confiabilidade para lidar diretamente com stakeholders estratégicos   Perfil proativo, com autonomia e senso de responsabilidade   Ambição profissional e vontade de crescer rapidamente   Capacidade de autogerenciamento e organização de demandas    O que fará você se destacar   Domínio técnico completo em vídeo, motion e Figma   Forte capacidade de organização e priorização   Mentalidade de Growth e foco em performance   Facilidade em lidar com ritmo acelerado e múltiplas entregas   Perfil "hands-on", que resolve problemas e não depende de microgerenciamento    O que pode gerar desalinhamento com a vaga   Perfil focado apenas em branding ou peças estáticas   Baixa experiência com vídeo e performance   Dificuldade em atuar com autonomia e comunicação direta com cliente   Postura excessivamente informal para ambientes executivos   Perfil dependente de gestão operacional constante    Benefícios do Investidor V4  Possibilidade de Sociedade (Partnership): O topo do nosso plano de carreira. Aqui, quem entrega performance fora da curva e alinhamento cultural de longo prazo se torna sócio do negócio.   Acesso à Staage: Conhecimento prático com a maior plataforma de marketing digital do país. Aprendizado contínuo para você acelerar seus resultados.   English Pass: Plataforma de inglês focada em negócios. Performance global exige comunicação global.  ️ Wellhub (Gympass): Energia alta, corpo e mente alinhados. Acesso às melhores academias, estúdios e experiências fitness do Brasil.   Starbem: Saúde integrada na palma da mão. Telemedicina com psicólogos, nutricionistas e mais de 16 especialidades médicas.   Plano Odontológico: Cuidado e saúde para o seu sorriso.  ️ Seguro de Vida: Proteção e tranquilidade para quem foca em construir o futuro.   Descontos em Graduação e Pós (Wyden): Incentivo e condições exclusivas para você continuar investindo na sua formação acadêmica.   iFood Benefícios: Liberdade e praticidade para sua alimentação no dia a dia presencial. OnHappy: Descontos e vantagens exclusivas em passagens e hospedagens. Porque descanso estratégico também é performance.   Day Off no Aniversário: Um dia totalmente seu para desligar a tela e comemorar.  ️ Recesso de Fim de Ano: Parada estratégica coletiva para recarregar as energias e abrir o próximo ano em ritmo de escala.   Aqui você terá espaço para construir, crescer e atuar em projetos com alto nível de exigência e impacto real em performance.

   PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES   • Prospectar, desenvolver e gerenciar oportunidades de vendas técnicas B2B nos segmentos e regiões definidos pela empresa;  • Atuar de forma consultiva na identificação de demandas, oportunidades de melhoria e soluções técnicas para os clientes;  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais e técnicas presenciais ou online com clientes, parceiros e integradores;  • Realizar visitas técnicas e viagens frequentes para prospecção, acompanhamento de projetos e relacionamento comercial;  • Analisar especificações técnicas, fluxos produtivos e requisitos operacionais para definição das soluções aplicáveis;  • Elaborar propostas técnico-comerciais de média e alta complexidade, assegurando alinhamento técnico, comercial e financeiro; title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.    Core Responsibilities:    Student Support & Intervention    Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.   Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.   Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.   Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.   Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.   Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.   Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.   Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.   Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.   Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.   Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.   Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.   Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.   Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.   Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.   Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.   Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.   Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.   Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.   Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.   Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.   Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).   Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.     Collaboration    Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.   Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.   Monitor students’ progress and well-being.   Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.   Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.   Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.   Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.   Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.   Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.   Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.     Operational and Professional Conduct    Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.   Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.   Maintain accurate student records.   Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.   Participate in professional development opportunities.   Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.   Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.   Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide  .     Other duties, as assigned.    Working Conditions:    Walk on paths and rough terrain   May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up      POSITION REQUIREMENTS    Minimum Education Required:     BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent   Minimum Experience Required:    Five years of teaching experience, preferred   Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.   Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.    Specific Knowledge:    Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.   Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.   Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.    Other Skills (Desirable):    Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.   Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.   Collegial and collaborative.   Innovative and creative.   Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.    English level required:    C1 or above   Portuguese level required:    none for teachers instructing in English   C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese     Child Safeguarding    Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.     EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion    EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Customer Care Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.    This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Supporting all post-sales activities.   Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations.   Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.   Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information.   Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met.   Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.   Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.   Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory.   Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.   Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system.   You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.     What You’ll Bring    Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.   Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.   Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.    Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at  .

Se você deseja fazer parte de uma empresa sólida, em crescimento e com atuação internacional, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade de se conectar com a gente. Sobre a LiuGong Latin America  A LiuGong Latin America (LGLA) foi fundada no Brasil em 2008 e é uma subsidiária integral do Grupo LiuGong. Desde 2015 fabricando equipamentos no país, a LiuGong vem crescendo nos mercados brasileiro e latino-americano. O negócio abrange a venda e manutenção de equipamentos e acessórios para máquinas de construção, soluções de financiamento, treinamento de clientes, consultoria técnica e outros escopos. Entre os principais produtos estão carregadeiras de rodas, escavadeiras, motoniveladoras, rolos compactadores, retroescavadeiras, caminhões rígidos e plataformas aéreas de trabalho. Além disso, a LiuGong continua expandindo sua estrutura com fábrica e centro de treinamento em Mogi Guaçu, além de escritórios em Campinas e Belo Horizonte, fortalecendo seu time e ampliando seu portfólio de soluções. Para saber mais, visite:   Sobre o Banco de Talentos  Este espaço foi criado para que profissionais interessados em fazer parte da LiuGong possam cadastrar seu currículo, mesmo que não haja uma vaga específica aberta no momento. Ao se candidatar, seu perfil ficará em nosso banco e poderá ser considerado para futuras oportunidades em diversas áreas, como: administrativa, comercial, engenharia, operações, supply chain, entre outras. Buscamos profissionais com perfil proativo, orientados a resultados, que queiram se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico e multicultural. Se você se identifica com a nossa empresa e deseja crescer com a gente, queremos te conhecer! Requisitos  Os requisitos variam de acordo com cada oportunidade, mas valorizamos profissionais que apresentem: Formação compatível com sua área de atuação Experiência prévia (quando aplicável) Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe Proatividade e senso de dono Interesse em desenvolvimento contínuo Disponibilidade para atuar de forma 100% presencial em Campinas  Idioma  O nível de inglês poderá variar conforme a posição. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas. Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias. Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico. Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina. Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:  Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.  Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:  Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão). Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas. Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago. Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.  Requisitos:  Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando. Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário. Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas). Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar em Campinas e Região.  Nós lhe propomos:  Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)  O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

description:

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:  The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region. Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning. In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Empresa está contratando Learning Support Teacher em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Job Overview:   The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.  Core Responsibilities:  Student Support & Intervention  Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.  Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.  Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.  Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.  Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.  Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.  Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.  Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.  Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.  Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.  Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.  Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.  Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.  Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.  Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.  Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.  Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.  Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.  Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.  Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.  Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.  Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).  Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.   Collaboration  Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.  Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.  Monitor students’ progress and well-being.  Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.  Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.  Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.  Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.  Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.  Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.  Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.   Operational and Professional Conduct  Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.  Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.  Maintain accurate student records.  Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.  Participate in professional development opportunities.  Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.  Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.  Follow the  EAC Safeguarding Guide.   Other duties, as assigned.  Working Conditions:  Walk on paths and rough terrain  May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up   POSITION REQUIREMENTS  Minimum Education Required:    BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent  Minimum Experience Required:  Five years of teaching experience, preferred  Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.  Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.   Specific Knowledge:  Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.  Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.  Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards. Collegial and collaborative.  Innovative and creative.  Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure. Linux Systems Engineer   Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure   DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux   SENIORITY: Mid · Senior   EXPERIENCE: 3+ years   STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit   01 About the role   We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.   02 What you'll own   Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints. 03 What you bring   MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE   3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs. NICE BONUS SIGNAL   Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot. 04 The kind of engineer this work asks for   Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for APPLY   Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior machine learning engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.   This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.   What you'll do   Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for   We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.   You'll be successful in this role if you have:   Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required)   Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us   You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.   Equal Opportunity   Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.   Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.   Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai development orchestrator em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote   Type: Full-Time   Reports to: CEO   Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git   Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users   Start: Immediate   The Company   Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.   The Role   You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.   Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.   What You Do   Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves   Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals   Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags   AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is   3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.   You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.   How We Evaluate   No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.   Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer   A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer   Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Pass Beyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. title: Professor de inglês
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Professor de inglês em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!   Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!   A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.   Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.   Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.   *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*   O que oferecemos?   Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?   Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.   Necessário:   Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?   Aqui você é mais que um professor.   Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.   Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.   Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.   Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.   Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço?   Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.   QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.   Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technical project manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical project manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Company   Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.   About the Role   The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.   Responsibilities   Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead. Qualifications   5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms. Required Skills   ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows. What Success Looks Like   Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process. Ideal Candidate   The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Professor de francês
description:

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.   *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*   O que oferecemos?   Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?   Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.   Necessário:   Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial?   Aqui você é mais que um professor.   Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.   Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.   Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.   Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.   Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço?   Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.   QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.   Seja diferente, seja independente

A sua missão como Motion Designer será transformar conceitos complexos, como roteamento inteligente, taxa de aprovação, antifraude, recuperação de vendas e inteligência de pagamentos, em vídeos, animações e peças visuais que prendem atenção, explicam com clareza e fortalecem a percepção da marca.   Buscamos uma pessoa criativa, detalhista e com repertório visual forte. Alguém que entenda que motion não é apenas "fazer elementos se mexerem", mas construir narrativa, ritmo e impacto visual.   Você vai trabalhar de perto com Marketing, Conteúdo, Design e fundadores, criando assets para redes sociais, campanhas, materiais comerciais, eventos, lançamentos e apresentações. Mais do que executar briefings, queremos alguém que proponha caminhos visuais, teste formatos e ajude a construir uma marca forte, moderna e memorável. VOCÊ TERÁ ENTRE SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:  Criar vídeos e animações para os canais oficiais da Pay Conductor, como Linked In, Instagram, You Tube, site e novos canais conforme estratégia. Desenvolver motion graphics para posts, carrosséis animados, reels, vídeos curtos, campanhas e materiais institucionais. Transformar roteiros e conceitos técnicos em animações claras, bonitas e fáceis de entender. Animar ícones, gráficos, interfaces, fluxos de pagamento, dashboards, transações e elementos visuais da marca. Apoiar a produção de vídeos para campanhas de mídia paga, eventos, lançamentos e ações comerciais. Criar variações de peças animadas para testes de performance e diferentes formatos de distribuição. Editar vídeos curtos com ritmo, cortes, legendas, trilhas, transições e acabamento profissional. Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com Design e Conteúdo para garantir coesão visual e narrativa da marca. Ajudar a evoluir a linguagem visual da Pay Conductor em movimento, respeitando identidade, paleta, tipografia e estilo da marca. Trazer referências visuais, tendências de motion, formatos de redes sociais e ideias para elevar a qualidade criativa dos conteúdos. VOCÊ AGREGARÁ SE POSSUIR: Portfólio com projetos de motion design, edição de vídeo, animação ou peças em movimento. Domínio de ferramentas como After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Cap Cut ou similares. Boa noção de composição visual, ritmo, hierarquia, transição, storytelling e acabamento. Sensibilidade estética para criar peças modernas, limpas e com aparência premium. Capacidade de transformar temas técnicos em narrativas visuais simples e interessantes. Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas em uma rotina dinâmica de marketing. Repertório ativo de referências visuais, redes sociais, design, tecnologia e cultura digital. Vontade de aprender sobre fintech, pagamentos, e-commerce e inteligência artificial. VOCÊ SE DESTACARÁ SE TIVER: Experiência prévia com marcas B2 B, Saa S, fintech, tecnologia, meios de pagamento ou e-commerce. Experiência com animação de UI, dashboards, fluxos de produto e interfaces digitais. Conhecimento em Lottie, Rive, Cinema 4 D, Blender ou outras ferramentas de animação/3 D. Experiência criando vídeos para campanhas de performance, anúncios e testes de criativos. Noções de design gráfico, direção de arte e criação de conceitos visuais. Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação, edição, storyboard ou geração de assets. Repertório de marcas com identidade visual forte, linguagem tecnológica e comunicação diferenciada. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:Esperamos uma pessoa com olhar apurado, autonomia criativa e vontade real de construir.   Alguém que consiga pegar um tema complexo e transformar em uma animação clara. Que saiba equilibrar estética com comunicação. Que entenda quando uma peça precisa ser mais institucional, mais comercial, mais educativa ou mais social-first.   Na Pay Conductor, você terá espaço para propor, testar e evoluir a linguagem visual de uma marca que está entrando em uma categoria nova e estratégica para o mercado brasileiro. Profile:   Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;   Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);   Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;   Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:  You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:  We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:  Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:  We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention   About The Role  We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS. You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.  As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will  Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation. Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices. You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools  to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)   What We Offer:  Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
