title: Post Producer
description:
Empresa está contratando Post Producer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Post Producer  Location:  Remote Position Type:  Contract Company:  Pocket FM About Us  At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer  to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content. Role Overview  As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners. Key Responsibilities  1. Post Production Operations Management   Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules. 2. Post Production Team Coordination   Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs. 3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management   Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline. 4. Stakeholder Collaboration   Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards. 5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight   Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release. 6. Vendor & Partner Management   Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners. 7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement   Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes. 8. Process & Workflow Optimization   Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution. 9. Volume & Deadline Management   Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards. 10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment  Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs. 11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership   Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives. 12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion  Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards. Qualifications  7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows. Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks. Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously. Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams. Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards. Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.  Qualifications  5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.  Required Skills  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.  Ideal Candidate  The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.  Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.   Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.  Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.  Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.  Competências Comportamentais:  Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:  Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia  de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.  Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.   Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.   Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..  Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)  or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)  markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo  - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital. Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global. Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais. Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer)  para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Responsabilidades:  Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Automatizar processos  de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade  dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .  Requisitos Técnicos:  Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL  e MongoDB . Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC)  com Terraform ou CloudFormation . Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python . Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade  (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD)  e Data Mesh . Conhecimento em CI/CD  e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native  e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .  O que você encontra aqui:  Remote First  – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas  – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback  – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). Horário Flexível  - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho. Incentivo ao Idioma  - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso! Wellhub  - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo. Reembolso de Equipamentos  – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation. Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success. description:
Empresa está contratando Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .  Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia  e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.  Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.  Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.  Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .  Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.  Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.  Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.  Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.   Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.  Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.  Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.  Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.  Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.  Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.  Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.   Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).  Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..  Competências Comportamentais:  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo. Realizar follow-up ativo para confirmar a resolução dos problemas e medir a satisfação (NPS, CSAT). Conduzir reuniões com clientes sempre que o caso exigir um alinhamento mais próximo. title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Quem somos?  Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds.   Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy:  Fazer acontecer:  A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito.  Jogar limpo:  Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente:  Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido:  Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro:  Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1:  Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho.  Feito é melhor que perfeito:  A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.    Qual o desafio?  Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados.   O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?  A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.    O que esperamos de você?  Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe:  Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação:  Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas:  Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia:  Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.    Quais são os requisitos?  Experiência de 3+ anos  em desenvolvimento de software; Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript  em produção  Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP  em produção; Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web  em produção; Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem; Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ); Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS  e/ou Next.js; Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID); Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código; Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban); Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.  Será um diferencial:  Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços; Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform; Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.); Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2); Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível:  Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto  (para candidatos de outras localidades); Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ; 6 dias de folga anuais + folga de aniversário; Bônus de indicação; Bônus de equipe; Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR); Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador; Horários flexíveis; Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!  Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

description:

Role Overview  We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades  to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics  across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Linux Systems Engineer
description:

Linux Systems Engineer  Embedded, IoT & Edge Infrastructure DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux SENIORITY: Mid · Senior EXPERIENCE: 3+ years STACK FOCUS: Yocto · WebKit 01 About the role  We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too. 02 What you'll own  Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. WebKit-based rendering (WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.  03 What you bring  MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE 3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.  NICE BONUS SIGNAL WebKit on embedded — WPE WebKit, WebKitGTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG webOS, Samsung Tizen, BrightSign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, mDNS. Security hardening / secure boot.  04 The kind of engineer this work asks for  Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly.On hardware they weren't designed for  APPLY Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence. This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us  Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description  As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: • Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  • Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  • Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  • Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  • Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  • Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  • Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  • Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  • Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: • At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience  • Strong Python skills  • Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3  • Real production experience with ML on AWS  • Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning  • Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data  • Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content  • A strong eye for correctness and data quality  • Business level English  • The ability to work independently in a small remote team  • A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions  • 12 month B2B contract • Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap • Flat structure with direct communication • Production product with real users and real data problems • Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence • Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:

About the Product  For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections. Role Overview  We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps)  to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder  for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts.  You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.  The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine  environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions. The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration strategy. Key Responsibilities  Infrastructure & Networking:  Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS  and Cloud NAT.  Linux System Administration:  Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues. VPN Management:  Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense  virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa  (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access. Performance Monitoring:  Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine  health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance. Resource Management:  Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene. Cost Optimization:  Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget. Database Oversight:  Provide support for PostgreSQL  and Oracle  environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem. Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter  Required Qualifications  Certification:  Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer  certification. Containerization Mastery:  Strong expertise with Docker  for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes. Scripting Mastery:  High proficiency in Python  or Bash  for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling. Networking Expertise:  Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense  and CloudConnexa.  Cloud Migration & Project Leadership:  Proven experience leading and running  application and data migrations from AWS  to GCP.  This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.  Compute Engine Mastery:  Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling. English Proficiency:  Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)  Nice-to-Have  PostgreSQL Expertise:  Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning. Oracle Expertise:  Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments. Data & Analytics:  Familiarity with BigQuery.   We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Integration Engineer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About the Product  Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI. We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI. Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow. The Team  At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design. We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record. About You  You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts. Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges. You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build. About the Role  Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into. A day’s work may include: Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems) Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture  Tech  Langs: Python / TS Infra: Nix, AWS Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)  What we’re looking for  Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours  What’s in it for you  This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly. We offer  We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.  As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre. About Fullinfo  Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform. The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources. The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense. The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. Role description  As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform. This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable. You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly. Your work includes: • Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda  • Building services across the data pipeline  • Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services  • Improving performance and cost efficiency  • Keeping the architecture clean and understandable  • Writing code that is easy to read, test and change  • Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular  • Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts. Requirements  You bring: • 5 plus years of backend engineering experience  • Strong TypeScript experience  • Real experience with AWS serverless services  • Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS  • A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability  • Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process  • Business level English  • You are based within 3 hours of Central European Time or are located in LATAM Conditions  • 12 month B2B contract • Fully remote work • Long term project with unlimited extensions  The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested?  Apply trough the link. Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

THE ROLE  The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure. WHAT YOU WILL DO  Learning Lab Architecture & Management  Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments. Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise. Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership. Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand. Support LMS system integrations as required. Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.  System Administration & Support  Allocate and reset user training accounts. Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms. Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed. Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience. Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience. Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes. Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.  Reporting & Documentation  Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures. Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance. Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.  WHAT IT TAKES  Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL. Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture. Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint. Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory. Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong technical writing and documentation skills. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities. Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred). title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Treasury Analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements. The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus) • Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries. • Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure. • Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements. • Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines. • Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements. • Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts. • Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations. • Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees. • Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled. • Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure. • Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region. Cash Management & Treasury Operations • Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies. • Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts. • Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations. • Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System. • Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations. • Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements. • Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories. • Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries. • Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management • Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts. • Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations. • Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience • Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees. • Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable. Technical Knowledge • Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds. • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements. • Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2). • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills. • Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure. • Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers. • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. • Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages • Advanced English (required). • Intermediate Spanish (desirable). Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

description:
